hypotheses.name: sentence position
hypotheses.what: target: 1-3 tokens into a sentence; source: 16+ tokens in; behavior: log P(next token ends a sentence or line)

hypotheses.name: chatty vs institutional
hypotheses.what: target: no I/you/! in the last 32 tokens; source: 4+ of them; behavior: log P(next token is I/you/!/a contraction)

hypotheses.name: prose vs structured
hypotheses.what: target: at most 1 of the last 16 tokens is markup; source: 8+; behavior: log P(next token is a newline, digit or symbol)
